text:
Situation: Methylprednisolone acetate injection 20 mg/mL, 5 mL vials are in shortage at Corvale East (2.7 days on hand) while Corvale General holds 22.8 days. The shortage has been posted by FDA since 2021-12-15 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Additional manufacturers listed on the FDA shortage page include Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Eugia US LLC, Par Health USA LLC, Pfizer Inc., and Sagent Pharmaceuticals.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2021-12-15. The Pharmacia & Upjohn plant (FEI 1810189) that labels NDC 00009027401 was inspected on 2023-06-16 and classified VAI, 548 days after the posting. An earlier VAI letter for the same plant is dated 2018-11-13, 1128 days before the posting, and the most recent letter is dated 2024-09-10, 1000 days after the posting.

Our position: Corvale East is critically low on the 20 mg/mL, 5 mL vial. Corvale General has sufficient stock to support an internal transfer without falling below a two‑week supply. Other Corvale sites have adequate days on hand for alternative strengths and dosage forms.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 61 vials of methylprednisolone acetate 20 mg/mL, 5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Transfer 5 vials of methylprednisolone acetate 40 mg/mL, 5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
3. Transfer 12 tablets of methylprednisolone 4 mg from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
4. Transfer 8 tablets of methylprednisolone 4 mg from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.

Not recommended: Purchase from Caplin Steriles Limited — the product is not on the FDA shortage list and its label does not identify a known manufacturing site.
